documentation.objective: Combine grid structure with trace recording; addressable space meets duration.

map_info.description:
The Grid provides the stable structure of space; the Trace records what happens within it. Where the Line reduces movement to an efficient relation, the Trace accumulates duration—sequence, hesitation, deviation. As a body moves, positions are recorded against the grid, forming a temporary history. Yet this history is bounded: memory is finite, motion is sampled, and deviation is measured relative to fixed frames. The Trace resists reduction, but only from within the grid that enables its capture, leaving a remainder that cannot be fully contained.

map_info.description_2: The Grid formalizes space into a system of addressability. By overlaying a coordinate structure, the map reveals how free space becomes indexed, repeatable, and computable. The player navigates a tension between embodied movement and numerical position, experiencing how grids enable calculation while simultaneously erasing local irregularities. This map exposes the political and technical consequences of choosing a coordinate system.
map_info.name: The Grid Trace
map_info.title: Grid Quantizes Movement

subtitles.grid: The grid quantizes: continuous movement snaps to discrete cells. This is how space becomes computable — and how the body's path becomes data.
